name: MonarchAiInsightCallout
title: AiInsightCallout
wrapsNative: HStack in a tinted RoundedRectangle with MonarchFlowLayout, DisclosureGroup with .disclosureGroupStyle(.monarch), MonarchButton and a plain Button
summary: A proactive insight about the current record or screen: what was noticed, why, optional evidence and one action, with its origin always shown as "AI insight" or "Rule-based".
whenToUse: On a record or dashboard, to surface something the person did not ask for (a risk, an anomaly, good news) together with the reason and where it came from.
whenNotToUse: For a system message about the app itself use MonarchCalloutBanner or MonarchInlineNotice. For an answer the person asked for, use the conversation. For a validation error, use the field's error text.
api: MonarchAiInsightCallout.init(_ title: String, why: String, origin: MonarchAiInsightOrigin, tone: MonarchTone = .info, actionTitle: String? = nil, isHeading: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels = MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels(), action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder evidence: () -> Evidence)

MonarchAiInsightCallout.init(_ title: String, why: String, origin: MonarchAiInsightOrigin, tone: MonarchTone = .info, actionTitle: String? = nil, isHeading: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels = MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels(), action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil) where Evidence == EmptyView
MonarchAiInsightCalloutLabels.init(tone: String? = nil, ai: String? = nil, rule: String? = nil, evidence: String? = nil, dismiss: String? = nil)

options.name: why
options.description: Why it was raised, in plain words.

options.name: origin
options.description: ai: produced by a model, shown with the assistant mark and colours. rule: raised by a fixed rule, shown with a checklist symbol in neutral colours.

options.name: tone
options.description: How much it matters: info, warning, danger (needs action now), success (good news) or neutral.

options.name: actionTitle
options.description: The title of the one follow-up action, shown as a small button when action is set.

options.name: isHeading
options.description: Gives the title the header trait for VoiceOver navigation.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces the spoken tone name, the origin texts, "Show evidence" and "Dismiss insight".

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Adds a dismiss button. The app removes the callout.

options.name: evidence
options.description: Supporting data in a collapsed disclosure group.

states.name: tone
states.description: The fill, border, leading bar and icon follow the tone.

states.name: origin ai
states.description: The origin label has the assistant subtle fill, border and strong text with the assistant mark.

states.name: origin rule
states.description: The origin label is on the surface colour with the default border, muted text and a checklist symbol.

states.name: evidence collapsed and expanded
states.description: The Monarch disclosure group shows or hides the evidence.

appearance: A rounded container with the tone's subtle fill and border and a 4-point leading bar in the tone's border colour; the icon uses the tone's strong colour; text uses the default text role. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web's severity (info, warning, critical, positive) maps to MonarchTone (info, warning, danger, success); neutral is also offered. The web's headingLevel becomes isHeading, since VoiceOver headings on iOS have no level. The web's action takes any content; on iOS it is a title and a closure. The parity map named MonarchCard; the web draws a tinted callout, so iOS follows the web look. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The title is read with the tone name first ("Warning: Renewal at risk"), so the tone is never colour alone; the tone also has its own symbol.
The origin label is read as text ("AI insight" or "Rule-based"); its symbol is hidden.
The evidence is a disclosure group with its expanded state.
The dismiss button is named "Dismiss insight" and is at least 44 by 44 points; the action button is a MonarchButton.
The callout is a container, so its parts are read in order.
Text wraps at every size; nothing has a fixed height.
edgeCases: actionTitle without action, or action without actionTitle, shows no button.
A long title takes its own line and the origin label moves under it.
An empty tone label override reads the title alone.
